variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/height
variables.description: Checkbox / radio box — 12px square

variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/width
variables.description: Switch track width — 32px (twice the 16px track height)

variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/dot
variables.description: Radio dot — 6px (half the 12px box)

variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/line-box
variables.description: Label line height (body sm, 21px) — the control centers on the label's first line.

variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/inset
variables.description: Switch thumb inset — 2px ((16px track − 12px thumb) ÷ 2). Switches only.

variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/radius
variables.description: Checkbox/radio corner — 2px, clamped to the 12px box (does not follow the radius scale).

variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/track
variables.description: Switch track height — 16px. Switches only.

variables.name: ads/control/size/sm/thumb
variables.description: Switch thumb — 12px (0.75 × the 16px track). Switches only.
